== Format ==
* '''Double-Elimination'''
* All upper bracket matches + lower bracket finals are BO3. All other lower bracket games are BO1. Grand Finals are BO5 (maps will be repeated for BO5 if needed).
* Seeding will be done by the almighty wisdom of Bance.

== Rules ==
* Map order: 

Use /cmd rnd to decide who picks first.

Pick order BO3/5: P1 → P2 → play last. (If BO5 losing player picks w/ repeats allowed after game 3)

Pick order BO1: P1ban → P2ban → play remaining map.

“Losing player” means the one trailing in total maps (e.g., 0–2 or 1–2), or if tied (1–1 or 2–2), the one who lost the previous map.

* Scheduling: '''IMPORTANT!''' The tournament will begin at 4pm EST and run until completion through the course of the afternoon/evening. Please stay on standby between rounds and be responsive to pings for your matches during the duration of the tournament.
* Settings: Standard settings by typing "/1on1" | To add match tag type "/1on1 MB Duel"
* Pause rules: Each player is allowed one pause per match only for extraneous circumstances like large PL, once you have used a pause and use it again, you have forfeited the map.
* Ping rules: This is an NA tournament so international players should expect to play on NA servers. Find a server that keeps all players around the same ping +-10ms if possible, if no such server can be found, the lowest ping players will have to use cl_delay_packet to get closer to the higher ping players. '''The max ping a player can be expected to ping up to is 50ms even if that means pings are uneven.''' If there's a dispute in what server should be used, contact admin on discord.
** Matches between NA/EU are suggested to play on NY servers.
** Players from Brazil can request the Miami or NY servers. 

* Client: ezquake 3.6.x. or unezquake 1.3.x. For your own sake, update your client!
** Remember to check with f_version
* Reporting: ping Bance with hub screenshots and he'll update the bracket.
* cl_idrive is NOT allowed, turn off your hardware SOCD functions if you have them.
